children: NightMode is set to introduce private cross-chain trade offers in Q1 2027. Traders will be able to use private offer files to carry out transactions across more than one network.
Traders can use the offer files to complete those transactions without revealing the strategy behind an offer. This extends NIGHT's privacy use case to trades that involve networks beyond Midnight.

💎 Collateral Warehouse - A private global collateral vault where traders can deposit assets once and use them as margin on compatible blockchains without the need for bridging or revealing any public data.

title: Midnight: NightMode introduces private cross-chain trade offers - Q1 2027
